arguments.message: Additional fact: the item is unused. Re-evaluate using only supplied facts.

payload.reply: {"status": "need_info", "result": "Policy criteria remain: (1) refund requested within 7 days of purchase, and (2) refund amount below SGD 100. The newly supplied fact that the item is unused is not a criterion under the stated policy, so it does not change the analysis (it could be relevant only under a different policy, e.g., change-of-mind returns). Without the purchase date and refund amount, neither policy condition can be verified and no approval decision can be made.", "missing": "Still required: (a) the purchase date or days elapsed since purchase (to verify the 7-day window), and (b) the refund amount in SGD (to verify it is below SGD 100)."}
